How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kharagpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Postdoc recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIT Kharagpur Postdoc recruitment is 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Postdoc position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Postdoc position at IIT Kharagpur as per the latest recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Postdoc role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a background in hardware security and a good academic record with publications in A/A* conferences in Security/AI areas.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Postdoc position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Postdoc position is 40 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per sponsor agency rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Postdoc position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of up to Rs. 100,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Postdoc recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Postdoc position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Postdoc position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Postdoc position is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Kharagpur located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur is located in Kharagpur, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the IIT Kharagpur Postdoc recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website or the provided apply link on or before the last date of application.
